people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
translations.bsb: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
translations.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
translations.asv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.
